recognize_zh: 視野中有兩顆體積很大、胞質豐富且呈粉紫色細顆粒狀的巨噬細胞（macrophage），其中一顆旁邊/內有一顆小圓核細胞，下方為一群深藍胞質的紅血球前驅細胞，顯示骨髓中巨噬細胞明顯增多。
features: Two large macrophages with abundant, finely granular to foamy pink-purple cytoplasm and indistinct borders
Macrophage nuclei oval to reniform with open chromatin
A small round dense nucleus closely associated with the left macrophage, possibly an engulfed or overlying cell
Cluster of erythroid precursors with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and a larger immature erythroid cell below
Blood-rich aspirate background with scattered platelets
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (Romanowsky stain, high power) shows two prominent macrophages with abundant, finely granular, pale pink-purple cytoplasm and oval to reniform nuclei; a small round nucleated cell lies closely apposed to one macrophage, although definite phagocytosis cannot be confirmed in this field. A cluster of basophilic erythroid precursors, including a larger immature erythroid cell, is also present. Clear engulfed red cells or platelets are not evident in these macrophages. The increased, activated macrophages support, but are not by themselves diagnostic of, a hemophagocytic process in the appropriate clinical context.

ddx.vs: Increased macrophages without convincing phagocytosed blood cells are nonspecific and require HLH-2004 clinical and laboratory criteria to diagnose HLH.
Gaucher cells have 'crumpled tissue paper' cytoplasm and Niemann-Pick cells have uniform bubbly foamy vacuoles, unlike these granular activated macrophages.
Megakaryocytes have multilobated dense nuclei and granular cytoplasm with platelet budding, whereas macrophages have a single oval nucleus with open chromatin.
Tumor cells form cohesive clusters with high N:C ratio and prominent nucleoli, unlike these single bland macrophages with low N:C ratio.
